description: Saves a full snapshot of the plan as a named version in the project history (for example before a large change); a person can restore it later from the web interface. It does not change the plan. Calling it twice saves two versions. Requires write permission.

name.description: Version name, e.g. 'Plan approved by the client'.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

name: planitude_save_version
title: Save named version
